name: safe-local-files
description: Audited, least-privilege, read-only access to one local directory through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Read and search one approved local folder.
interface.longDescription: A local-only MCP plugin for bounded, audited, read-only file listing, search, metadata, and text retrieval. It enforces a configured root, bearer authentication, deny rules, secret detection, rate limits, and response limits.
defaultPrompt: Search my approved local folder for project notes.
Read a file from my approved local folder.
List the top level of my approved local folder.
